description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence. Join a supportive environment committed to providing high-quality care to its residents.As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and fostering a culture of compassionate and effective patient care. You will lead, mentor, and develop a team of nursing professionals, driving continuous improvement in clinical outcomes and resident satisfaction.This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, commensurate with your experience and leadership capabilities. If you are a dynamic RN leader ready to take on a pivotal role, we encourage you to apply promptly.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role (e.g., ADON, DON)
Experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage a nursing team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $85,000 to $95,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
